title: Perfect Squares
summary: Write n as a sum of positive perfect squares, allowing repeated squares.

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Write n as a sum of positive perfect squares, allowing repeated squares. Return the smallest number of summands.

examples.explanation: The input is itself a square.

hints: Conceptual: Choosing one square leaves a smaller remainder.
Directional: Compute best counts for remainders up to n.
Implementation: Try each square no larger than the current amount, taking one plus the best count for the leftover amount.
complexityAnalysis: O(n√n) time and O(n) auxiliary space.
